name: Infinite Rotating Gallery
description: Full-screen WebGL gallery of images stacked vertically in an endless loop. Scrolling, wheel or dragging moves them while each plane flips in 3D with a smooth distortion.
contents: Vertical endless column of image planes rendered on a full-screen canvas
Pulsing loader dot shown until images are loaded
behavior: Mouse wheel and drag or touch move the gallery with eased inertia
Images rotate in 3D with a vertex distortion based on their position
Planes wrap around infinitely in both directions
Canvas fades in once all images are preloaded
editableByProps: Images, background color and loader color
Plane size, gap, scroll and drag feel, camera, distortion and rotation settings
Loader visibility and fade duration, pixel ratio cap

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the image fit or shading

fixed: Listens to wheel, mouse and touch events on window while mounted and removes them on unmount
Canvas is fixed to the full viewport and sized from the window
Section is one viewport tall with touch scrolling disabled on it
Requires the ogl package, loaded by dynamic import
